coordinator_decision.context: Pre-implementation decision for the frozen first-norm SANITY_ONLY semantic experiment after three versioned review cycles.
rationale: The mathematical reviewer returned GO for the degree-preserving Frobenius representative, multidegrees, Hilbert caps, source coefficients, projective scaling, and repaired pure-squaring boundary.
The benchmark reviewer independently recomputed the complete cell matrix, operation counts, controls, comparators, cohort semantics, deterministic success boundary, and v3 traffic ceiling.

The red team returned GO after the v3 access model added materialization, pivot scans, fused elimination updates, normalization, certificate reads, extension conversion, metadata separation, and invalidation gates.

The authoritative specification remains draft: this decision approves implementation and development replay, not canonical execution or any compiler, locator, relation-generation, asymptotic, or ECDLP claim.
limitations: Approval is limited to toy generated curves and the exact frozen cell and mutation schedules.
Full B^5 enumeration remains diagnostic work and cannot be retained or reported as source advice.
Toy exact ranks may saturate ambient B^2 and support no fitted asymptotic exponent.
The first norm theorem does not construct coefficient-space advice, compress h^(p-1), localize zeros, produce relations, solve an ECDLP, or beat rho.
Canonical execution still requires implementation review, exact source hashes, an approved execution plan, and an external approval lock.
next_actions: Implement the generator, non-importing verifier, mutation runner, and focused tests against the exact draft specification, without changing any frozen v3 protocol artifact.
